text:
marie: Quick sync — registry ingestion / curation handoff. We have the final batch of open models ready for vetting and want to make sure ownership, licensing, and perf profiles are squared away before the catalog freeze tomorrow morning. Anyone with blockers?

sam: I pulled the ingest list: 8 models (mostly 3–7B families). Two items outstanding: license text for open-rev-7b and perf profile for clem-6b-quant.

leo: I have the license draft for open-rev-7b, but the CLA/history check flagged a potential non-commercial clause in a dependency. Posting notes in the thread. We should avoid adding until we confirm.

anya: For clem-6b-quant perf, infra ran a quick latency sweep on A100 and T4. Results look fine for throughput but tails exceed our 200ms SLO at seq_len=512. Need a small kernel tweak or fall back to 8-bit GEMM variant.

marie: Noted. Can we triage the dependency/legal flag today? If legal can't greenlight, we need a fallback model for the catalog entry.

leo: I'll escalate to OSS counsel now. ETA 4h. If they flag it, propose we mark open-rev-7b as "license review pending" in the catalog UI and do not enable dedicated routing.

sam: Sounds good. For ownership: assign model product owners for each entry? I suggest: marie -> open-rev-7b, anya -> clem-6b-quant, tim -> ingest pipeline / QA.
note: The thread string above contains all messages in chronological order as a single Slack thread text.
